items.title: How the 2026 World Cup affected Internet traffic
items.summary: We analyzed global HTTP traffic to explore how kickoff times, streaming habits, and hydration breaks reshaped online activity worldwide. From late-night traffic surges to halftime browsing spikes, here is how the world connected during the global tournament.
items.author: Sabina Zejnilovic

items.title: Cloudflare Internal DNS is now generally available
items.summary: Cloudflare Internal DNS brings authoritative and recursive DNS for private networks to the same global network and control plane that runs Cloudflare's Zero Trust, networking, and public DNS.
items.author: Enrique Somoza

items.title: Cloudflare WAF protects WordPress applications from two high-severity vulnerabilities
items.summary: Cloudflare has deployed two WAF rules in response to high-severity vulnerabilities disclosed to us by the WordPress security team. The new rules protect all Cloudflare customers using affected WordPress versions, but customers should still update immediately to a patched release
items.author: Daniele Molteni

items.title: A broken DNSSEC rollover took down .al. Now 1.1.1.1 tells you when validation is bypassed
items.summary: When a failed DNSSEC key rollover took down the .al TLD, we deployed a Negative Trust Anchor to restore resolution. This time, though, clients didn't have to take our word for it: 1.1.1.1 returned EDE 33, a new DNS error code that signals directly in the response that DNSSEC validation was bypassed.
items.author: Sebastiaan Neuteboom

items.title: Introducing Precursor: detecting agentic behavior with continuous client-side signals
items.summary: Precursor, our new continuous behavioral validation engine for bot management, offers visibility into how humans and bots actually interact across the full user journey. By turning session-level behavior into bot detection signals, it identifies advanced automation with higher precision — while…
items.author: Marina Elmore

items.title: Improving Smart Tiered Cache for Public Cloud Regions
items.summary: Smart Tiered Cache allows for precise upper tier selection for origins hosted on AWS, GCP, Azure, and Oracle Cloud with customer-provided cloud region hints.
items.author: Chenxi Zhang

items.title: Why we cannot wait for better post-quantum signature algorithms
items.summary: NIST is advancing nine new post-quantum signature algorithms as potential candidates for future standardization. We take a closer look at all of them, and argue that while they are in the works and show great potential, we should use ML-DSA for now — the best one currently available.
items.author: Bas Westerbaan

items.title: Introducing Meerkat: an experiment in global consensus
items.summary: Cloudflare Research is building a global consensus service called Meerkat that uses a new consensus algorithm called QuePaxa. We plan to use Meerkat to build a strongly consistent, fault-tolerant key-value store, and other applications.
items.author: James Larisch

items.title: Cloudflare proudly joins the UK government's Cyber Resilience Pledge
items.summary: The pledge is a voluntary framework inviting organizations to commit to foundational cyber security governance, board-level accountability, and supply chain rigor. For over a decade, Cloudflare has pioneered the core pillars of this framework: democratizing security, leadership accountability, and…
items.author: Ling Wu

items.title: Your Worker can now have its own cache in front of it
items.summary: We are launching Workers Cache, a regionally tiered cache that sits directly in front of your Worker entrypoints. Infinitely composable, configured via standard HTTP headers
items.author: Dan Lapid

items.title: Unmasking the crawls with Attribution Business Insights
items.summary: Cloudflare’s new Attribution Business Insights dashboard helps website owners understand crawler behavior, appetite, and potential value, fueling business-level conversations around crawl compensation.
items.author: Jin-Hee Lee

items.title: Making AI search smarter
items.summary: Search is how we find nearly everything on the web — creators, merchants, answers. AI is rewriting the rules, leaving creators caught between staying discoverable in an agentic era and getting paid for their work. Today we're launching two initiatives to help.
items.author: Matthew Conroy

items.title: Your site, your rules: new AI traffic options for all customers
items.summary: For our second Content Independence Day, we’re giving website owners finer options to manage AI traffic. Instead of a one-size-fits-all block, all customers can now easily distinguish and manage Search, Agent, and Training bots, alongside the new ability to protect ad-monetized pages.
items.author: Jin-Hee Lee

items.title: Announcing the Monetization Gateway: charge for any resource behind Cloudflare via x402
items.summary: We're opening the waitlist for our Monetization Gateway, which will allow you to charge for any web page, dataset, API, or MCP tool behind Cloudflare. The charges will settle in stablecoins over the x402 open protocol, with no payments stack of your own to build.
items.author: Rohin Lohe

items.title: Content Independence Day, one year on: building the business model for the agentic Internet
items.summary: One year after declaring Content Independence Day, a dynamic market for monetized content has officially emerged. In this report, we examine how the rise of autonomous AI agents is upending traditional search referrals and detail the new infrastructure required to support a sustainable web economy.
items.author: Arielle Weiss

items.title: How we built saga rollbacks for Cloudflare Workflows
items.summary: Cloudflare Workflows, our durable execution engine for multi-step applications, now supports saga-style rollbacks, allowing developers to specify a compensating action for each step.do().
items.author: Vaishnav Kavitha

items.title: Unlocking the Cloudflare app ecosystem with OAuth for all
items.summary: Self-Managed OAuth is now available to all developers on Cloudflare. Here's how we executed a zero-downtime migration of our core OAuth engine to make it happen.
items.author: Sam Cabell

items.title: The White House's post-quantum executive order is an important milestone. It’s time to get to work
items.summary: The new executive order sets a 2030 migration deadline and establishes a powerful foundation for post-quantum resilience. We look at what it gets right, where it can go further, and our migration playbook for government and industry.
items.author: Sharon Goldberg

items.title: How we found a bug in the hyper HTTP library
items.summary: By rearchitecting the Images binding, we accidentally uncovered a bug that existed in the open-source hyper library across multiple major versions.
items.author: Deanna Lam

items.title: Temporary Cloudflare Accounts for AI agents
items.summary: The moment an agent needs to deploy something, it slams face-first into a wall built for humans. Today we're rolling out Temporary Accounts on Cloudflare Workers. Any agent can now run wrangler deploy — temporary and get a live Worker in seconds.
items.author: Sid Chatterjee
